_**User (2026-03-13 20:38:46Z)**_

DeviceID und DeviceKey sind essentielle Informationen die ein einzelnes Device Identifizieren und Absichern. Ein Weiteres Detail ist die  Deviceliste.

1. ich möchte den "Show onboarding wizard again" button auf das location tracking status view verlagern (direkt unterhalb der versionsnummer

2. ich möchte in den Settings unterhalb des Location Tracking Status links ein neuen link auf ein neues sheet "Backup and Restore" setzen. Dieses Sheet erlaubt dem Nutzer die DeviceID + DeviceKey als "username + password" kombination in die system-keychain/passwords app zu senden. Ich stelle mir das so vor dass die jeweils vom nutzer auf dem gerät verwendete password app signalisiert bekommt dass hier ein neuer username+pw verwendet wird und diesen dann abspeichern kann/soll/vom nutzer speichern abfragen soll.

3. zusätzlich soll der nutzer die möglichkeit haben die Device-Liste zu exportieren. Hierbei wird die DeviceListe in ein neuen QR Code mit der uri miatarulist:// möglichst platzsparend überführt. 

4. die app soll an alle stellen an denen deviceid und devicekey eingegeben werden kann so geändert werden dass dort die jeweiligen password-dialoge abrufbar sind, also der devicekey direkt als password eingefügt werden kann sowie die deviceid als "username"

5. es soll diese deviceid-devicekey eingabe direkt als restore funktion geben, gleichzeitig mit einer device-listen-einlese funktion für den devicelisten-backup-qr-code.

6. die app soll auf die miatarulist:// uri korrekt reagieren und den restore-deviceliste-dialog öffnen. Grundsätzlich soll der QR code auf fehlerfreiheit geprüft werden, dann soll die deviceliste aus dem qr code angezeigt werden und der nutzer soll die möglichkeit haben devices auszuwählen die importiert werden sollen. Jeder Import erzeugt auch eine device gruppe mit allen zusammen importierten devices.

Analysiere seiteneffekte und frage nach/gib ratschläge wie so eine backup/restore funktion im kontext der app, inklusive der sicherheitsanforderungen und serverkommunikation implementiert werden kann. 

Es ist wichtig dass alles auch korrekt dokumentiert und übersetzt ist. Weise auf etwaige sicherheitsprobleme mit den codes hin. Es soll auch auf dem backup/restore dialog alles korrekt und ausführlich erklärt werden , ablauf, implikationen wenn man etwas verliert etc.

extension UserDefaults {
    var hasCompletedOnboarding: Bool {
        get { bool(forKey: "hasCompletedOnboarding") }
        set { set(newValue, forKey: "hasCompletedOnboarding") }
    }

    var hasShownPostUpdateOnboarding: Bool {

    }

    }
}

class AppState: ObservableObject {
    @Published var showOnboarding: Bool
    @Published var onboardingMode: OnboardingMode

    init() {
        let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
        if !defaults.hasCompletedOnboarding {
            onboardingMode = .full
            showOnboarding = true
            return
        }

        if !defaults.hasShownPostUpdateOnboarding, defaults.hadLocationTrackingEnabled {
            onboardingMode = .postUpdate
            showOnboarding = true
            return
        }

        onboardingMode = .full
        showOnboarding = false
    }

    func presentFullOnboarding(skipPostUpdate: Bool) {
        if skipPostUpdate {
            UserDefaults.standard.hasShownPostUpdateOnboarding = true
        }
        onboardingMode = .full
        showOnboarding = true
    }
}

@MainActor
fileprivate final class LaunchGuard {
    static var isFirstActivation: Bool = true
}

fileprivate final class RotationLockController {
    static let shared = RotationLockController()

    private var isRotationLocked = false
    private var lockedOrientationMask: UIInterfaceOrientationMask = .portrait

    private init() {}

    func supportedInterfaceOrientations(for window: UIWindow?) -> UIInterfaceOrientationMask {
        guard isRotationLocked else { return .all }
        return lockedOrientationMask
    }

    func setRotationLockEnabled(_ enabled: Bool) {
        if !Thread.isMainThread {
            DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
                self?.setRotationLockEnabled(enabled)
            }
            return
        }

        isRotationLocked = enabled
        if enabled {
            lockedOrientationMask = currentInterfaceOrientationMask()
        }

        let targetMask = isRotationLocked ? lockedOrientationMask : .all
        let scenes = UIApplication.shared.connectedScenes.compactMap { $0 as? UIWindowScene }

        for scene in scenes {
            scene.windows.forEach { $0.rootViewController?.setNeedsUpdateOfSupportedInterfaceOrientations() }
            if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {
                let preferences = UIWindowScene.GeometryPreferences.iOS(interfaceOrientations: targetMask)
                scene.requestGeometryUpdate(preferences) { error in
                    debugLog("Failed to update orientation preferences: \(error.localizedDescription)")
                }
            }
        }

    }

    private func currentInterfaceOrientationMask() -> UIInterfaceOrientationMask {
        if let orientation = currentInterfaceOrientation() {
            return mask(for: orientation)
        }
        return .portrait
    }

    private func currentInterfaceOrientation() -> UIInterfaceOrientation? {
        let scenes = UIApplication.shared.connectedScenes.compactMap { $0 as? UIWindowScene }
        if let activeScene = scenes.first(where: { $0.activationState == .foregroundActive }) {
            return activeScene.interfaceOrientation
        }
        return scenes.first?.interfaceOrientation
    }

    private func mask(for orientation: UIInterfaceOrientation) -> UIInterfaceOrientationMask {
        switch orientation {
        case .landscapeLeft:
            return .landscapeLeft
        case .landscapeRight:
            return .landscapeRight
        case .portraitUpsideDown:
            return .portraitUpsideDown
        default:
            return .portrait
        }
    }
}

            let myDevice = KnownDevice(name: myDeviceName, deviceID: myDeviceID, color: UIColor.systemBlue)
            self.devices.insert(myDevice, at: 0)
            debugLog("[DEBUG] Eigenes Gerät mit DeviceID \(myDeviceID) wurde automatisch als erstes Device hinzugefügt.")
            save()
        }
        setupSubscribers()
        isInitializing = false
    }

    private func setupSubscribers() {
        cancellables = []
        for device in devices {
            let c = device.objectWillChange
                .sink { [weak self] _ in
                    self?.save()
                    WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()
                }
            cancellables.append(c)
        }
    }

    private func save() {
       do {
            let data = try NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: devices, requiringSecureCoding: true)
            try data.write(to: fileURL)
        } catch {
            debugLog("Fehler beim Speichern der KnownDevices: \(error)")
        }
        //print("Speichern ist temporär deaktiviert - muss repariert werden!!!")
    }

    private func load() -> [KnownDevice] {
        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }
        do {
            if let devices = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, KnownDevice.self, UIColor.self], from: data) as? [KnownDevice] {
                // Nach gespeicherter Reihenfolge sortieren
                return devices.sorted { $0.KnownDevicesTablePosition < $1.KnownDevicesTablePosition }
            }
        } catch {
            debugLog("Fehler beim Laden der KnownDevices: \(error)")
        }
        return []
    }

    /// Fügt ein Gerät hinzu, wenn die DeviceID noch nicht existiert. Gibt true zurück, wenn erfolgreich, false bei Duplikat.
    @discardableResult
    func add(device: KnownDevice) -> Bool {
        if devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == device.DeviceID }) {
            return false
        }
        devices.append(device)
        return true
    }

    func move(fromOffsets source: IndexSet, toOffset destination: Int) {
        devices.move(fromOffsets: source, toOffset: destination)
        // Reihenfolge-Index aktualisieren
        for (index, device) in devices.enumerated() {
            device.KnownDevicesTablePosition = index
        }
        save()
    }

    func remove(atOffsets offsets: IndexSet) {
        // Get device IDs that will be removed
        let deviceIDsToRemove = offsets.map { devices[$0].DeviceID }
        
        // Remove devices from the list
        devices.remove(atOffsets: offsets)
        
        // Remove devices from all groups
        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: deviceIDsToRemove)
        
        save()
    }
    
    func removeDevice(byID deviceID: String) {
        // Remove device from the list
        devices.removeAll { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }
        
        // Remove device from all groups
        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [deviceID])
        
        save()
    }
    
    private func removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [String]) {
        let groupStore = DeviceGroupStore.shared
        
        for group in groupStore.groups {
            var changed = false
            for deviceID in deviceIDs {
                if group.deviceIDs.contains(deviceID) {
                    group.removeDevice(deviceID)
                    changed = true
                }
            }
            if changed {
                group.objectWillChange.send()
            }
        }
    }
}

    @Published @objc var groupName: String {

        }

            objectWillChange.send()
        }

    }

        self.groupName = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: "groupName") as? String ?? ""
        if let deviceIDsArray = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: "deviceIDs") as? [String] {
            self.deviceIDs = Set(deviceIDsArray)
        }
        self.groupPosition = aDecoder.decodeInteger(forKey: "groupPosition")
    }
    
    func encode(with aCoder: NSCoder) {
        aCoder.encode(groupName, forKey: "groupName")
        aCoder.encode(Array(deviceIDs), forKey: "deviceIDs")
        aCoder.encode(groupPosition, forKey: "groupPosition")
    }
    
    static var supportsSecureCoding: Bool {
        return true
    }
    
    func addDevice(_ deviceID: String) {
        deviceIDs.insert(deviceID)
    }
    
    func removeDevice(_ deviceID: String) {
        deviceIDs.remove(deviceID)
    }
    
    func containsDevice(_ deviceID: String) -> Bool {
        return deviceIDs.contains(deviceID)
    }
    
    func toggleDevice(_ deviceID: String) {
        if containsDevice(deviceID) {
            removeDevice(deviceID)
        } else {
            addDevice(deviceID)
        }
    }
}

    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {
        guard url.scheme == "miataru" else { return }
        let deviceID = url.host ?? ""
        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }

        Task { @MainActor in
            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL
            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.
            await Task.yield()
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)

            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.
            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {

                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID

            }

    private static func applyUITestLaunchConfiguration() {
        let args = ProcessInfo.processInfo.arguments
        guard args.contains(UITestLaunchArgument.uiTesting) else { return }

        let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
        if args.contains(UITestLaunchArgument.resetUserDefaults),
           let bundleID = Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier {
            defaults.removePersistentDomain(forName: bundleID)
        }

        if args.contains(UITestLaunchArgument.showOnboarding) {
            defaults.hasCompletedOnboarding = false
            defaults.hasShownPostUpdateOnboarding = false
        }

        if args.contains(UITestLaunchArgument.onboardingCompleted) {
            defaults.hasCompletedOnboarding = true
            defaults.hasShownPostUpdateOnboarding = true
        }

        if args.contains(UITestLaunchArgument.disableLocationTracking) {
            defaults.set(false, forKey: "track_and_report_location")
        }

        let hasExplicitInitialTab: Bool
        if let initialTabIndex = args.firstIndex(of: UITestLaunchArgument.initialTab),
           args.indices.contains(initialTabIndex + 1),
           let tabValue = Int(args[initialTabIndex + 1]) {
            defaults.set(tabValue, forKey: "ui_test_initial_tab")
            hasExplicitInitialTab = true
        } else {
            defaults.removeObject(forKey: "ui_test_initial_tab")
            hasExplicitInitialTab = false
        }

        let isScreenshotMode = args.contains(UITestLaunchArgument.screenshotMode)
        defaults.set(isScreenshotMode, forKey: "ui_test_is_screenshot_mode")

        var screenshotScenarioID: String?
        if let scenarioIndex = args.firstIndex(of: UITestLaunchArgument.screenshotScenario),
           args.indices.contains(scenarioIndex + 1) {
            screenshotScenarioID = args[scenarioIndex + 1]
            defaults.set(screenshotScenarioID, forKey: "ui_test_screenshot_scenario")
        } else {
            defaults.removeObject(forKey: "ui_test_screenshot_scenario")
        }

        if isScreenshotMode {
            applyUIScreenshotDeterministicState(
                defaults: defaults,
                scenarioID: screenshotScenarioID,
                hasExplicitInitialTab: hasExplicitInitialTab
            )
        }
    }

    private static func applyUIScreenshotDeterministicState(defaults: UserDefaults,
                                                            scenarioID: String?,
                                                            hasExplicitInitialTab: Bool) {
        defaults.set(false, forKey: "track_and_report_location")
        defaults.set(true, forKey: "hasShownPostUpdateOnboarding")
        defaults.removeObject(forKey: "lastOpenedDeviceID")

        guard !hasExplicitInitialTab, let scenarioID else { return }

        switch scenarioID {
        case "root-devices", "devices-add-sheet":
            defaults.set(0, forKey: "ui_test_initial_tab")
        case "root-qr", "qr-device-key":
            defaults.set(1, forKey: "ui_test_initial_tab")
        case "root-settings", "settings-show-onboarding", "settings-navigation":
            defaults.set(2, forKey: "ui_test_initial_tab")
        case "groups-tab":
            defaults.set(1, forKey: "ui_test_initial_tab")
        default:
            break
        }
    }

            saveDeviceID(newID)
            cachedDeviceID = newID
            return newID
        }
        cachedDeviceID = loaded
        return loaded
    }

    func setDeviceID(_ id: String) {

            debugLog("[DEBUG] Ignoring empty deviceID set request.")
            return

        cachedDeviceID = trimmed

            DispatchQueue.main.async {

                    object: nil,
                    userInfo: [
                        "oldDeviceID": oldID ?? "",
                        "newDeviceID": trimmed

                )
            }
        }
    }

    private func uniqueLegacyDeviceName(baseName: String, existingNames: Set<String>) -> String {
        let suffix = String(localized: "device_key_old_device_suffix")
        let numberedSuffixFormat = String(localized: "device_key_old_device_suffix_numbered")

        var candidate = "\(baseName) \(suffix)"
        if !existingNames.contains(candidate) {
            return candidate
        }

        var index = 2
        while index < 10_000 {
            let numberedSuffix = String(format: numberedSuffixFormat, locale: Locale.current, index)
            candidate = "\(baseName) \(numberedSuffix)"
            if !existingNames.contains(candidate) {
                return candidate
            }
            index += 1
        }

        return "\(baseName) \(suffix)"
    }

    private func localizedMessage(for error: Error) -> String {
        if let apiError = error as? MiataruAPIClient.APIError {
            return apiErrorMessage(apiError)
        }
        return error.localizedDescription
    }

    private func isForbiddenError(_ error: MiataruAPIClient.APIError) -> Bool {
        guard case .serverError(let statusCode, _) = error else { return false }
        return statusCode == 403
    }

    private func apiErrorMessage(_ error: MiataruAPIClient.APIError) -> String {
        switch error {
        case .serverError(_, let message):
            return message
        case .invalidURL:
            return NSLocalizedString("device_key_error_invalid_server", comment: "Error when server URL is invalid")
        case .invalidResponse:
            return NSLocalizedString("device_key_error_invalid_response", comment: "Error when server response is invalid")
        case .encodingError:
            return NSLocalizedString("device_key_error_encoding", comment: "Error when request encoding fails")
        case .decodingError:
            return NSLocalizedString("device_key_error_decoding", comment: "Error when response decoding fails")
        case .requestFailed:
            return NSLocalizedString("device_key_error_request_failed", comment: "Error when request fails")
        }
    }

    private var keyCardColor: Color {
        switch keyCardState {
        case .success:
            return .green
        case .failure, .mismatch:
            return .red
        case .normal:
            return .blue
        }
    }
}

Die technischen Voraussetzungen sind da:

- iOS Passwords-App: Ein garantiertes direktes Speichern in Apples Passwords-App koennen wir nicht sauber versprechen. AutoFill-faehige Felder, Keychain-Migration und ein systemnaher Save/Share-Flow sind realistisch.
- Restore plus ACL-Merge: Das ist machbar, aber wir muessen den Write-Schutz nach dem Merge sauber einziehen, damit der erste spaetere ACL-Sync nicht unbeabsichtigt den Serverzustand ueberschreibt.
- `DeviceKey`-Migration: Die Umstellung von `UserDefaults` auf Keychain braucht eine saubere Einmalmigration und Regression-Tests, ist aber technisch unkompliziert.

_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-03-13 20:38:46Z)**_

Der Write-Schutz beim ACL-Merge ist kein Extra-Feature aus Prinzip. Er verhindert einen sehr konkreten Fehlerfall im aktuellen Verhalten der App.

Heute ist die Allowed-Device-List client-seitig als Voll-Liste modelliert:
- `AllowedDeviceListManager.syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(...)` baut immer die komplette Liste aus `KnownDeviceStore.devices`.
- `setAllowedDeviceList` ersetzt serverseitig den gesamten ACL-Zustand mit genau dieser Liste.

Nach einem Restore mit `getAllowedDeviceList` passiert deshalb sonst leicht Folgendes:
- Wir stellen `DeviceID` + `DeviceKey` erfolgreich wieder her.
- Wir laden die serverseitige ACL.
- Wir mergen sie lokal mit der bereits vorhandenen lokalen Device-Liste.
- Danach aendert der Nutzer irgendein lokales Device oder fuegt eines hinzu.
- Der naechste normale ACL-Sync schreibt dann die komplett gemergte lokale Liste zum Server.

Das Problem daran:
- Diese lokale Liste ist nach dem Restore nicht automatisch “serverwahr”.
- Sie enthaelt lokale Altlasten, lokale Namen/Farben und eventuell lokale Devices, die auf dem wiederhergestellten Serverzustand nie Teil der ACL waren.
- Ohne Schutz wird aus einem reinen Restore sehr schnell eine unbeabsichtigte serverseitige ACL-Aenderung.

Mit Write-Schutz meine ich deshalb:
- Nach Restore und ACL-Download markieren wir den Zustand als “Review erforderlich”.
- Solange dieser Zustand aktiv ist, duerfen die bestehenden automatischen ACL-Schreibpfade keinen `setAllowedDeviceList` absetzen.
- Erst wenn der Nutzer die zusammengefuehrte Liste bewusst bestaetigt, wird wieder normal geschrieben.

Das ist technisch simpel, aber wichtig, weil der aktuelle Manager Voll-Replace macht und kein Patch-/Merge-API hat.

Zum zweiten Punkt: Die Migration in den Keychain war keine technische Notwendigkeit, sondern eine Sicherheitsentscheidung.
Wenn du `UserDefaults` als Master behalten willst, ist das moeglich. Dann wuerde ich den Plan so anpassen:

- `UserDefaults` bleibt Source of Truth fuer die App.
- Keychain wird zusaetzlich als Komfort-/Integrationsspeicher verwendet.
- Restore schreibt zuerst nach `UserDefaults`, danach optional gespiegelt in den Keychain.
- Startup liest primaer aus `UserDefaults`; Keychain ist nur Fallback oder fuer systemnahe Flows.
- Bei Abweichungen zwischen `UserDefaults` und Keychain gewinnt `UserDefaults`.

Die Nachteile dieses Modells sind aber real:
- Das Geheimnis bleibt weiterhin im weniger geeigneten Speicher liegen.
- Du hast zwei Kopien eines Secrets und musst Divergenzregeln definieren.
- Ein “in Passwortmanager speichern” ist konzeptionell schwaecher, wenn die App selbst weiter ihren Master in `UserDefaults` fuehrt.

Technisch ist das trotzdem machbar. Es ist eine Produkt- und Sicherheitsentscheidung, kein Blocker.

Ich wuerde hier jetzt zwei Dinge festzurren, weil sie den Implementierungsplan deutlich aendern.

PLEASE IMPLEMENT THIS PLAN:
# Backup & Restore fuer DeviceID, DeviceKey und Allowed Device List

## Zusammenfassung
- `Show Onboarding Wizard Again` wird aus den Settings in die `Location Tracking Status`-Ansicht verschoben, direkt unter den Versionsblock.
- In den Settings kommt unter dem bestehenden `Location Tracking Status`-Link ein neuer Eintrag `Backup and Restore`.
- `Backup and Restore` wird der zentrale Flow fuer:
  - Anzeige und Erklaerung von `DeviceID` und `DeviceKey`
  - passwortmanager-freundliche Nutzung als `username` + `password`
  - Restore der eigenen Identitaet per `DeviceID` + `DeviceKey`
  - serverseitiges Nachladen der Allowed-Device-List nach erfolgreichem Restore
  - interaktiven Vergleich zwischen lokaler und serverseitiger Device-Liste mit Nutzerentscheidung vor dem finalen Merge und sofortigem Server-Sync
- `UserDefaults` bleibt die kanonische Quelle fuer den eigenen `DeviceKey`; Keychain wird zusaetzlich genutzt, nicht als Master.

## Implementierungsplan
- Navigation und Screens:
  - `iPhone_SettingsView` erhaelt einen neuen `NavigationLink` oder Sheet-Trigger `Backup and Restore`.
  - `iPhone_LocationStatusView` bekommt unter dem Versionsblock den bestehenden Onboarding-Reset-Button mit derselben Aktion und stabiler Accessibility-ID.
  - Der neue `Backup and Restore`-Screen enthaelt:
    - `Current credentials`: `DeviceID` sichtbar, `DeviceKey` maskiert mit Reveal.
    - `Save for later`: Copy-/Share-Aktionen und klare Hinweise zur Ablage im bevorzugten Passwortmanager.
    - `Restore`: Eingabe von `DeviceID` und `DeviceKey` als Username-/Password-Felder.
- Credential-Speicherung:
  - `UserDefaults` bleibt Source of Truth fuer `deviceKey`.
  - Ein zusaetzlicher `DeviceCredentialStore` kapselt Keychain-Zugriffe fuer Spiegelung und systemnahe Integration.
  - App-Startup liest primaer aus `UserDefaults`; Keychain ist nur Zusatzspeicher bzw. Fallback fuer UX-nahe Flows, falls gewuenscht.
  - Bei Divergenz gewinnt `UserDefaults`.
  - Nicht-geheime Metadaten (`deviceKeyLastChanged`, Auth-Flags) bleiben unveraendert in `UserDefaults`.
- Password-Integration:
  - Restore-Formular: `DeviceID` als `.username`, `DeviceKey` als `.password`.
  - Bestehende DeviceKey-Eingabe-Sheets werden ebenfalls als Password-Felder markiert.
  - Bestehende `DeviceID`-Eingabefelder, insbesondere in `iPhone_AddDeviceView`, werden als Username-Felder markiert.
  - Die App verspricht keinen garantierten direkten Write in Apples Passwords-App, sondern liefert AutoFill-faehige Felder, Copy/Share und Keychain-Spiegelung.
- Restore der eigenen Identitaet:
  - Restore ersetzt die aktuelle Identitaet `in place`.
  - Vor dem eigentlichen Restore zeigt die App eine deutliche Warnung ueber Folgen fuer Tracking, Visitor-History, ACL und Serverzuordnung.
  - Credential-Validierung erfolgt bevorzugt read-only ueber `getDeviceSecurityStatus` mit der eingegebenen `DeviceID` und dem eingegebenen `DeviceKey`.
  - Nach erfolgreicher Validierung werden lokal `thisDeviceIDManager`, `SettingsManager.deviceKey`, Auth-Flags, eigene Device-Zeile, Gruppenreferenzen, `lastOpenedDeviceID`, Widget-Konfiguration und relevante Caches auf die wiederhergestellte Identitaet umgestellt.
- Nachladen und Vergleich der Allowed-Device-List:
  - Direkt nach erfolgreichem Restore ruft die App `getAllowedDeviceList(serverURL:deviceID:deviceKey:)` fuer die wiederhergestellte Identitaet auf.
  - Die Rueckgabe wird nicht automatisch angewendet, sondern in einen Vergleichsdatensatz fuer einen neuen Restore-Abgleichs-Dialog ueberfuehrt.
  - Der Dialog stellt lokale und serverseitige Liste gegenueber und bietet drei Aktionen:
    - `Abbrechen`: Restore-Flow wird ohne ACL-Uebernahme beendet; die wiederhergestellte Identitaet bleibt gesetzt, aber es erfolgt kein ACL-Sync.
    - `Lokal komplett durch Server ersetzen`: lokale Device-Liste wird fuer den ACL-relevanten Zustand aus der Serverliste neu aufgebaut.
    - `Selektiver Merge`: Nutzer waehlt, welche serverseitigen Devices uebernommen werden sollen.
  - Bei DeviceIDs, die lokal und serverseitig bereits existieren, zeigt der Dialog einen echten Konflikt und laesst den Nutzer pro Konflikt entscheiden.
  - Bei server-only Devices zeigt der Dialog eine einfache Uebernahme-Auswahl.
  - Lokal-only Devices bleiben beim selektiven Merge erhalten, ausser der Nutzer waehlt die Komplett-Ueberschreibung.
- Konflikt- und Merge-Regeln:
  - `Komplett ersetzen`:
    - Die lokale ACL-relevante Device-Liste wird durch die Serverliste ersetzt.
    - Name und Farbe fuer serverseitige Devices ohne lokale Entsprechung werden lokal mit Default-Werten erzeugt.
  - `Selektiver Merge`:
    - Pro Konflikt-Device entscheidet der Nutzer lokal vs. serverseitig.
    - Wenn lokal gewaehlt wird, bleiben lokale Name/Farbe/ACL/Metadaten erhalten.
    - Wenn serverseitig gewaehlt wird, werden fuer diese DeviceID die ACL-Werte vom Server uebernommen; Name/Farbe werden, falls serverseitig nicht vorhanden, weiter lokal belassen oder mit Default erzeugt, je nach vorhandener lokaler Entsprechung.
    - Server-only Devices werden nur uebernommen, wenn der Nutzer sie auswaehlt.
  - Nach Abschluss der Nutzerentscheidung wird das resultierende lokale Set sofort per `setAllowedDeviceList` zum Server synchronisiert.
  - `SettingsManager.allowedDeviceListEnabled` wird auf Basis des resultierenden Zielzustands und des serverseitigen `IsAllowedDeviceListEnabled` konsistent gesetzt.
- Fehlerverhalten:
  - Schlaegt die Credential-Validierung fehl, wird nichts lokal geaendert.
  - Schlaegt `getAllowedDeviceList` nach erfolgreichem Restore fehl, bleibt die Identitaet wiederhergestellt, aber der Nutzer sieht einen klaren Fehlerzustand mit Retry fuer den Listenabgleich.
  - Schlaegt der finale `setAllowedDeviceList` nach einer Nutzerentscheidung fehl, wird der lokale Zustand auf den Stand vor dem Listenabgleich zurueckgerollt oder der Fehler explizit als nicht synchronisierter Zustand dargestellt; das muss als atomarer Restore-Schritt implementiert werden.
  - Der Nutzer kann den Listenabgleich abbrechen; dieser Abbruch darf keine stillen ACL-Schreibvorgaenge ausloesen.

## Wichtige Schnittstellen und Zustandsaenderungen
- Neue App-seitige API-Erweiterung in `MiataruAppAPI` fuer `getAllowedDeviceList(...)`, passend zur bereits erweiterten Client-Library.
- Neuer lokaler `DeviceCredentialStore` fuer optionale Keychain-Spiegelung.
- Neuer Restore-Abgleichs-ViewModel-/State-Typ fuer:
  - lokale Liste
  - serverseitige Liste
  - Konfliktstatus pro `DeviceID`
  - Nutzerentscheidung pro Konflikt
  - Auswahl server-only Devices
  - Modus `abbrechen / selektiver merge / komplett ersetzen`
- Der bestehende `AllowedDeviceListManager` braucht einen expliziten Restore-Pfad, der:
  - Snapshots fuer Rollback bilden kann
  - Resultatslisten anwenden kann
  - danach genau einen finalen Sync ausloest

## Dokumentation und Lokalisierung
- Alle neuen Texte kommen vollstaendig in `Assets/Localizable.xcstrings`.
- `Backup and Restore` erklaert ausfuehrlich:
  - Bedeutung von `DeviceID` und `DeviceKey`
  - Sicherheitsimplikationen bei Verlust oder Weitergabe
  - Auswirkungen eines Restores auf diese App-Installation
  - Bedeutung des nachgelagerten Device-Listen-Abgleichs
  - Unterschied zwischen lokaler Liste, serverseitiger ACL und finalem Sync
  - Risiken von Screenshots, Clipboard und Passwortmanager-Sync ueber iCloud oder Drittanbieter
- Repo-Dokumentation:
  - neues Ablaufdokument fuer Restore, Listenvergleich, Konfliktaufloesung, Rollback und `UserDefaults`-plus-Keychain-Modell
  - knapper `CHANGELOG.md`-Eintrag

## Tests
- UI-Tests:
  - `Backup and Restore` ist in den Settings erreichbar.
  - `Show Onboarding Wizard Again` ist im `Location Tracking Status`-Screen vorhanden.
  - Restore-Form nutzt Username-/Password-Felder.
  - Nach erfolgreichem Restore erscheint der Listenvergleichs-Dialog.
  - Der Dialog unterstuetzt `Abbrechen`, `Komplett ersetzen` und `Selektiver Merge`.
  - Konflikt-Devices lassen sich einzeln aufloesen.
- Unit-/Integrations-Tests:
  - `UserDefaults` bleibt Master, Keychain-Spiegelung ist konsistent.
  - Erfolgreicher Restore aktualisiert Identitaet, Gruppenreferenzen, `lastOpenedDeviceID` und Widget-Sync.
  - `getAllowedDeviceList`-Antwort wird korrekt in ein Vergleichsmodell ueberfuehrt.
  - Selektiver Merge uebernimmt nur ausgewaehlte serverseitige Devices.
  - Konfliktentscheidungen pro `DeviceID` werden korrekt angewendet.
  - Komplett-Ueberschreibung ersetzt den ACL-relevanten lokalen Zustand deterministisch.
  - Fehler im finalen `setAllowedDeviceList` fuehren nicht zu still inkonsistentem Zustand.
- Manuelle Checks:
  - Tracking funktioniert nach Restore unter der neuen Identitaet.
  - Auth-Fehlerbanner verschwinden nach erfolgreichem Restore.
  - Lokalisierungen, Accessibility-IDs und sensible Darstellungen sind korrekt.

## Annahmen
- `UserDefaults` bleibt bewusst die kanonische Quelle fuer den eigenen `DeviceKey`.
- Keychain wird nur zusaetzlich genutzt und ueberschreibt `UserDefaults` nicht automatisch.
- Der Listenabgleich ist Teil des Restore-Flows, aber die finale ACL-Aenderung auf dem Server erfolgt erst nach expliziter Nutzerentscheidung.
- Bei Konflikten zwischen lokaler und serverseitiger DeviceID entscheidet der Nutzer pro Eintrag.

            }

            defer { isSyncing = false }

/*

import Foundation
import Combine
import MiataruAPIClient

class DeviceHistoryCacheStore: ObservableObject {
    static let shared = DeviceHistoryCacheStore()
    static let activeHistoryCacheMaxAge: TimeInterval = 120
    private static let knownLocationLeadTolerance: TimeInterval = 60

    private struct CachedHistoryEntry {
        let history: [MiataruLocationData]
        let fetchedAt: Date
        let newestTimestamp: Date?
    }

    @Published private var histories: [String: CachedHistoryEntry] = [:]
    private init() {}

    func setHistory(_ history: [MiataruLocationData], for deviceID: String, fetchedAt: Date = Date()) {
        let newestTimestamp = history.map(\.TimestampDate).max()
        histories[deviceID] = CachedHistoryEntry(
            history: history,
            fetchedAt: fetchedAt,
            newestTimestamp: newestTimestamp
        )
    }

    func getHistory(for deviceID: String) -> [MiataruLocationData]? {
        histories[deviceID]?.history
    }

    func removeHistory(for deviceID: String) {
        histories.removeValue(forKey: deviceID)
    }

    func shouldRefreshHistory(for deviceID: String,
                              latestKnownLocationTimestamp: Date?,
                              maxAge: TimeInterval = DeviceHistoryCacheStore.activeHistoryCacheMaxAge) -> Bool {
        guard let entry = histories[deviceID] else { return true }

        if maxAge > 0, Date().timeIntervalSince(entry.fetchedAt) > maxAge {
            return true
        }

        guard let latestKnownLocationTimestamp else {
            return false
        }

        if let newestTimestamp = entry.newestTimestamp {
            return latestKnownLocationTimestamp.timeIntervalSince(newestTimestamp) > Self.knownLocationLeadTolerance
        }

        return latestKnownLocationTimestamp.timeIntervalSince(entry.fetchedAt) > Self.knownLocationLeadTolerance
    }

}

version 3.1.4
- Extended `MiataruClientSwift` with typed support for `getAllowedDeviceList` (`MiataruGetAllowedDeviceList` request and `MiataruAllowedDeviceList` response model).
- Added `MiataruAPIClient.getAllowedDeviceList(...)` for authenticated owner reads against `v1/getAllowedDeviceList`.
- Updated `MiataruClientSwift` README with usage documentation and example code for `getAllowedDeviceList`.
- Fixed intermittent Devices-list refresh flicker where rows briefly dropped all supplemental information and showed only the device name during active polling.
- Coalesced overlapping device-list refresh requests into a single in-flight fetch and now apply refreshed device-location cache data as one consolidated snapshot instead of publishing per-device partial states.
- Kept the last successful device-location cache visible on transient refresh failures, avoiding the short-lived blank/half-empty list state during network hiccups.
- Fixed standard navigation summary countdown on iPhone and iPad so ETA/distance no longer jump from the initially correct route values to `0 km / 0 min` right after route calculation.
- Standard `device -> user` navigation now seeds live summary updates from the moment the active route is applied (including cached routes), instead of reusing potentially stale device sample timestamps.
- Added centralized device-slogan cleansing before every `setDeviceSlogan` request (remove control characters, trim outer whitespace, enforce max length 40) so invalid special/control characters are not sent to the server.
- Replaced raw server error text in slogan-save UI with a user-friendly localized fallback message ("Beim Setzen des Device Slogans ist etwas schief gelaufen. Probier es später noch einmal.") across all supported app languages.
- Added optional slogan rendering in the Devices tab list rows (iPhone + iPad): when a device slogan exists, it is shown directly below the device name.
- Matched device-list slogan styling to Visitor History by using secondary text color for a consistent, slightly darker subtitle appearance.

- Simplified navigation duration formatting to hour+minute granularity only (removed seconds) for more compact route info on smaller devices.
- Simplified the iOS 26 bottom accessory arrival segment to show only the arrival clock time, removing the localized `ETA:`/`Ankunft:` prefix.
- Extended `MiataruClientSwift` with typed support for `getDeviceSecurityStatus` (`MiataruGetDeviceSecurityStatus` request and `MiataruDeviceSecurityStatus` response model).
- Added `MiataruAPIClient.getDeviceSecurityStatus(...)` for authenticated security-status checks against `v1/getDeviceSecurityStatus`.
- Added app-level wrapper `MiataruAppAPI.getDeviceSecurityStatus(...)` so app callsites can use the centralized request executor and read retry policy.
- Updated `MiataruClientSwift` README with usage documentation and example code for `getDeviceSecurityStatus`.

- Added status color coding in that row: active (`green`), inactive (`red`), unknown/loading (`secondary`) with unknown fallback on missing credentials or API/auth/network errors.
- Added full localization coverage for the new Edit Device security-status texts across all supported app languages (`da`, `de`, `en`, `es`, `fi`, `fr`, `it`, `ja`, `nl`, `zh-Hans`).

+/*
+ * Copyright (c) 2013-2026, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com
+ *
+ * DeviceCredentialStore.swift
+ * miataru
+ *
+ * Created by Codex on 13.03.26.
+ */
+
+import Foundation
+import Security
+
+final class DeviceCredentialStore {
+    static let shared = DeviceCredentialStore()
+
+    private let service: String
+    private let account = "device_key"
+
+    private init() {
+        self.service = Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier ?? "com.miataru.ios"
+    }
+
+    func resolvedDeviceKey(preferredUserDefaultsValue: String?) -> String? {
+        let trimmedDefaultsValue = preferredUserDefaultsValue?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
+        if let trimmedDefaultsValue, !trimmedDefaultsValue.isEmpty {
+            setDeviceKey(trimmedDefaultsValue)
+            return trimmedDefaultsValue
+        }
+
+        return deviceKey()
+    }
+
+    func deviceKey() -> String? {
+        var query = baseQuery()
+        query[kSecReturnData as String] = true
+        query[kSecMatchLimit as String] = kSecMatchLimitOne
+
+        var item: CFTypeRef?
+        let status = SecItemCopyMatching(query as CFDictionary, &item)
+
+        guard status == errSecSuccess,
+              let data = item as? Data,
+              let key = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8),
+              !key.isEmpty else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        return key
+    }
+
+    func setDeviceKey(_ key: String?) {
+        guard let key, !key.isEmpty else {
+            deleteDeviceKey()
+            return
+        }
+
+        let data = Data(key.utf8)
+        let query = baseQuery()
+        let attributes: [String: Any] = [
+            kSecValueData as String: data,
+            kSecAttrAccessible as String: kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlock
+        ]
+
+        let updateStatus = SecItemUpdate(query as CFDictionary, attributes as CFDictionary)
+        if updateStatus == errSecItemNotFound {
+            var insert = query
+            insert[kSecValueData as String] = data
+            insert[kSecAttrAccessible as String] = kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlock
+            let addStatus = SecItemAdd(insert as CFDictionary, nil)
+            if addStatus != errSecSuccess {
+                debugLog("[DeviceCredentialStore] Failed to add device key to Keychain: \(addStatus)")
+            }
+        } else if updateStatus != errSecSuccess {
+            debugLog("[DeviceCredentialStore] Failed to update device key in Keychain: \(updateStatus)")
+        }
+    }
+
+    func deleteDeviceKey() {
+        let status = SecItemDelete(baseQuery() as CFDictionary)
+        if status != errSecSuccess && status != errSecItemNotFound {
+            debugLog("[DeviceCredentialStore] Failed to delete device key from Keychain: \(status)")
+        }
+    }
+
+    private func baseQuery() -> [String: Any] {
+        [
+            kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
+            kSecAttrService as String: service,
+            kSecAttrAccount as String: account
+        ]
+    }
+}

+import Foundation

+
+struct DeviceGroupRestoreSnapshot {
+    let groupName: String
+    let deviceIDs: Set<String>
+    let groupPosition: Int
+}
+
+struct DeviceRestoreStateSnapshot {
+    let activeDeviceID: String
+    let activeDeviceKey: String?
+    let activeDeviceKeyLastChanged: Date?
+    let activeDeviceKeyAuthBlocked: Bool
+    let activeDeviceKeyAuthBlockedKey: String?
+    let allowedDeviceListEnabled: Bool
+    let lastOpenedDeviceID: String?
+    let knownDevices: [KnownDeviceSnapshot]
+    let groups: [DeviceGroupRestoreSnapshot]
+}
+
+enum AllowedDeviceRestoreConflictChoice: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
+    case keepLocal
+    case useServer
+
+    var id: String { rawValue }
+}
+
+struct AllowedDeviceRestoreConflict: Identifiable {
+    let deviceID: String
+    let localDevice: KnownDeviceSnapshot
+    let serverDevice: KnownDeviceSnapshot
+    var choice: AllowedDeviceRestoreConflictChoice = .keepLocal
+
+    var id: String { deviceID }
+}
+
+struct AllowedDeviceRestoreServerCandidate: Identifiable {
+    let device: KnownDeviceSnapshot
+    var isSelected: Bool = true
+
+    var id: String { device.deviceID }
+}
+
+struct AllowedDeviceRestoreComparison {
+    let ownerDeviceID: String
+    let serverAllowedDeviceListEnabled: Bool
+    let localDevices: [KnownDeviceSnapshot]
+    let localOnlyDevices: [KnownDeviceSnapshot]
+    var conflicts: [AllowedDeviceRestoreConflict]
+    var serverOnlyDevices: [AllowedDeviceRestoreServerCandidate]
+
+    var hasDecisionsToMake: Bool {
+        !conflicts.isEmpty || !serverOnlyDevices.isEmpty || serverAllowedDeviceListEnabled
+    }
+}
+
+enum AllowedDeviceRestoreApplyMode {
+    case replaceLocalWithServer
+    case selectiveMerge
+}
+
+@MainActor
+final class DeviceRestoreCoordinator {
+    static let shared = DeviceRestoreCoordinator()
+
+    private let settings = SettingsManager.shared
+    private let deviceStore = KnownDeviceStore.shared
+    private let groupStore = DeviceGroupStore.shared
+
+    private init() {}
+
+    func validateRestoreCredentials(deviceID: String, deviceKey: String, serverURL: URL) async throws -> MiataruDeviceSecurityStatus {
+        try await MiataruAppAPI.getDeviceSecurityStatus(
+            serverURL: serverURL,
+            forDeviceID: deviceID,
+            requestingDeviceID: deviceID,
+            requestingDeviceKey: deviceKey
+        )
+    }
+
+    func captureCurrentState() -> DeviceRestoreStateSnapshot {
+        DeviceRestoreStateSnapshot(
+            activeDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID,
+            activeDeviceKey: settings.deviceKey,
+            activeDeviceKeyLastChanged: settings.deviceKeyLastChanged,
+            activeDeviceKeyAuthBlocked: settings.deviceKeyAuthBlocked,
+            activeDeviceKeyAuthBlockedKey: settings.deviceKeyAuthBlockedKey,
+            allowedDeviceListEnabled: settings.allowedDeviceListEnabled,
+            lastOpenedDeviceID: settings.lastOpenedDeviceID,
+            knownDevices: deviceStore.devices.map { device in
+                KnownDeviceSnapshot(
+                    deviceID: device.DeviceID,
+                    deviceName: device.DeviceName,
+                    deviceColor: device.DeviceColor,
+                    deviceIsInGroup: device.DeviceIsInGroup,
+                    knownDevicesTablePosition: device.KnownDevicesTablePosition,
+                    hasCurrentLocationAccess: device.hasCurrentLocationAccess,
+                    hasHistoryAccess: device.hasHistoryAccess
+                )
+            },
+            groups: groupStore.groups.map { group in
+                DeviceGroupRestoreSnapshot(
+                    groupName: group.groupName,
+                    deviceIDs: group.deviceIDs,
+                    groupPosition: group.groupPosition
+                )
+            }
+        )
+    }
+
+    func rollback(to snapshot: DeviceRestoreStateSnapshot) {
+        thisDeviceIDManager.shared.setDeviceID(snapshot.activeDeviceID)
+        settings.deviceKey = snapshot.activeDeviceKey
+        settings.deviceKeyLastChanged = snapshot.activeDeviceKeyLastChanged
+        settings.deviceKeyAuthBlocked = snapshot.activeDeviceKeyAuthBlocked
+        settings.deviceKeyAuthBlockedKey = snapshot.activeDeviceKeyAuthBlockedKey
+        settings.allowedDeviceListEnabled = snapshot.allowedDeviceListEnabled
+        settings.lastOpenedDeviceID = snapshot.lastOpenedDeviceID
+        applyDeviceSnapshots(snapshot.knownDevices)
+        restoreGroups(snapshot.groups)
+    }
+
+    func applyRestoredIdentity(restoredDeviceID: String, deviceKey: String) -> DeviceRestoreStateSnapshot {
+        let snapshot = captureCurrentState()
+        let oldDeviceID = snapshot.activeDeviceID
+        let normalizedOldID = oldDeviceID.uppercased()
+        let normalizedNewID = restoredDeviceID.uppercased()
+
+        thisDeviceIDManager.shared.setDeviceID(restoredDeviceID)
+        settings.deviceKey = deviceKey
+        settings.deviceKeyLastChanged = Date()
+        settings.deviceKeyAuthBlocked = false
+        settings.deviceKeyAuthBlockedKey = nil
+        settings.allowedDeviceListEnabled = false
+        if snapshot.lastOpenedDeviceID?.uppercased() == normalizedOldID {
+            settings.lastOpenedDeviceID = restoredDeviceID
+        }
+
+        var snapshots = snapshot.knownDevices
+        let oldIndex = snapshots.firstIndex { $0.deviceID.uppercased() == normalizedOldID }
+        let newIndex = snapshots.firstIndex { $0.deviceID.uppercased() == normalizedNewID }
+
+        if let newIndex, let oldIndex, newIndex != oldIndex {
+            snapshots.remove(at: oldIndex)
+        } else if let oldIndex {
+            let old = snapshots[oldIndex]
+            snapshots[oldIndex] = KnownDeviceSnapshot(
+                deviceID: restoredDeviceID,
+                deviceName: old.deviceName,
+                deviceColor: old.deviceColor,
+                deviceIsInGroup: old.deviceIsInGroup,
+                knownDevicesTablePosition: old.knownDevicesTablePosition,
+                hasCurrentLocationAccess: old.hasCurrentLocationAccess,
+                hasHistoryAccess: old.hasHistoryAccess
+            )
+        } else if newIndex == nil {
+            let ownDevice = KnownDeviceSnapshot(
+                deviceID: restoredDeviceID,
+                deviceName: NSLocalizedString("my_device", comment: "Name for the user's own device in the device list"),
+                deviceColor: UIColor.systemBlue,
+                deviceIsInGroup: false,
+                knownDevicesTablePosition: 0,
+                hasCurrentLocationAccess: true,
+                hasHistoryAccess: true
+            )
+            snapshots.insert(ownDevice, at: 0)
+        }
+
+        normalizePositions(&snapshots)
+        applyDeviceSnapshots(snapshots)
+        migrateGroups(from: oldDeviceID, to: restoredDeviceID)
+        copyOwnCaches(from: oldDeviceID, to: restoredDeviceID)
+
+        NotificationCenter.default.post(
+            name: .deviceIdentityDidReset,
+            object: nil,
+            userInfo: ["newDeviceID": restoredDeviceID]
+        )
+        NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .deviceKeyAuthResolved, object: nil)
+        restoreTrackingStateAfterAuthRecovery()
+
+        return snapshot
+    }
+
+    func buildComparison(serverList: MiataruAllowedDeviceList) -> AllowedDeviceRestoreComparison {
+        let localSnapshots = captureCurrentState().knownDevices.sorted { $0.knownDevicesTablePosition < $1.knownDevicesTablePosition }
+        let localByID = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: localSnapshots.map { ($0.deviceID.uppercased(), $0) })
+
+        var localOnly: [KnownDeviceSnapshot] = []
+        var conflicts: [AllowedDeviceRestoreConflict] = []
+        var serverOnly: [AllowedDeviceRestoreServerCandidate] = []
+
+        let serverIDs = Set(serverList.allowedDevices.map { $0.DeviceID.uppercased() })
+        for local in localSnapshots where !serverIDs.contains(local.deviceID.uppercased()) {
+            localOnly.append(local)
+        }
+
+        for (index, serverDevice) in serverList.allowedDevices.enumerated() {
+            let normalizedID = serverDevice.DeviceID.uppercased()
+            let serverSnapshot = makeServerSnapshot(from: serverDevice, fallbackPosition: index)
+
+            if let local = localByID[normalizedID] {
+                conflicts.append(
+                    AllowedDeviceRestoreConflict(
+                        deviceID: serverDevice.DeviceID,
+                        localDevice: local,
+                        serverDevice: serverSnapshot
+                    )
+                )
+            } else {
+                serverOnly.append(AllowedDeviceRestoreServerCandidate(device: serverSnapshot))
+            }
+        }
+
+        return AllowedDeviceRestoreComparison(
+            ownerDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID,
+            serverAllowedDeviceListEnabled: serverList.IsAllowedDeviceListEnabled,
+            localDevices: localSnapshots,
+            localOnlyDevices: localOnly,
+            conflicts: conflicts.sorted { $0.localDevice.knownDevicesTablePosition < $1.localDevice.knownDevicesTablePosition },
+            serverOnlyDevices: serverOnly
+        )
+    }
+
+    func resultSnapshots(for comparison: AllowedDeviceRestoreComparison, mode: AllowedDeviceRestoreApplyMode) -> [KnownDeviceSnapshot] {
+        switch mode {
+        case .replaceLocalWithServer:
+            return replacementSnapshots(for: comparison)
+        case .selectiveMerge:
+            return mergedSnapshots(for: comparison)
+        }
+    }
+
+    func applyDeviceSnapshots(_ snapshots: [KnownDeviceSnapshot]) {
+        let sortedSnapshots = snapshots.sorted { $0.knownDevicesTablePosition < $1.knownDevicesTablePosition }
+        let devices = sortedSnapshots.map { snapshot -> KnownDevice in
+            let device = KnownDevice(
+                name: snapshot.deviceName,
+                deviceID: snapshot.deviceID,
+                color: snapshot.deviceColor,
+                hasCurrentLocationAccess: snapshot.hasCurrentLocationAccess,
+                hasHistoryAccess: snapshot.hasHistoryAccess
+            )
+            device.DeviceIsInGroup = snapshot.deviceIsInGroup
+            device.KnownDevicesTablePosition = snapshot.knownDevicesTablePosition
+            return device
+        }
+        deviceStore.devices = devices
+        filterGroupsToKnownDevices()
+    }
+
+    func syncAppliedAllowedDeviceList(trigger: SyncTrigger = .restore) async throws {
+        guard let deviceKey = settings.deviceKey, !deviceKey.isEmpty else {
+            throw AllowedDeviceListError.deviceKeyMissing
+        }
+        guard let serverURL = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else {
+            throw AllowedDeviceListError.serverURLInvalid
+        }
+
+        settings.allowedDeviceListEnabled = true
+        do {
+            try await AllowedDeviceListManager.shared.syncCurrentDeviceList(
+                serverURL: serverURL,
+                deviceKey: deviceKey,
+                trigger: trigger
+            )
+        } catch {
+            settings.allowedDeviceListEnabled = false
+            throw error
+        }
+    }
+
+    private func replacementSnapshots(for comparison: AllowedDeviceRestoreComparison) -> [KnownDeviceSnapshot] {
+        let localByID = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: comparison.localDevices.map { ($0.deviceID.uppercased(), $0) })
+        var result: [KnownDeviceSnapshot] = []
+        let ownerID = comparison.ownerDeviceID.uppercased()
+
+        if let existingOwner = localByID[ownerID] {
+            result.append(existingOwner)
+        }
+
+        for (index, serverCandidate) in comparison.serverOnlyDevices.enumerated() {
+            let snapshot = withPosition(serverCandidate.device, position: index + result.count)
+            if snapshot.deviceID.uppercased() != ownerID {
+                result.append(snapshot)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for conflict in comparison.conflicts {
+            let snapshot = resolvedConflictSnapshot(conflict)
+            if snapshot.deviceID.uppercased() == ownerID {
+                if let ownerIndex = result.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID.uppercased() == ownerID }) {
+                    result[ownerIndex] = withPosition(snapshot, position: result[ownerIndex].knownDevicesTablePosition)
+                } else {
+                    result.insert(snapshot, at: 0)
+                }
+            } else {
+                result.append(snapshot)
+            }
+        }
+
+        normalizePositions(&result)
+        return result
+    }
+
+    private func mergedSnapshots(for comparison: AllowedDeviceRestoreComparison) -> [KnownDeviceSnapshot] {
+        var result = comparison.localDevices.sorted { $0.knownDevicesTablePosition < $1.knownDevicesTablePosition }
+
+        for conflict in comparison.conflicts {
+            guard conflict.choice == .useServer,
+                  let index = result.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID.uppercased() == conflict.deviceID.uppercased() }) else {
+                continue
+            }
+
+            let local = result[index]
+            result[index] = KnownDeviceSnapshot(
+                deviceID: local.deviceID,
+                deviceName: local.deviceName,
+                deviceColor: local.deviceColor,
+                deviceIsInGroup: local.deviceIsInGroup,
+                knownDevicesTablePosition: local.knownDevicesTablePosition,
+                hasCurrentLocationAccess: conflict.serverDevice.hasCurrentLocationAccess,
+                hasHistoryAccess: conflict.serverDevice.hasHistoryAccess
+            )
+        }
+
+        let nextBasePosition = (result.map(\.knownDevicesTablePosition).max() ?? -1) + 1
+        var appendOffset = 0
+        for candidate in comparison.serverOnlyDevices where candidate.isSelected {
+            let snapshot = withPosition(candidate.device, position: nextBasePosition + appendOffset)
+            result.append(snapshot)
+            appendOffset += 1
+        }
+
+        normalizePositions(&result)
+        return result
+    }
+
+    private func resolvedConflictSnapshot(_ conflict: AllowedDeviceRestoreConflict) -> KnownDeviceSnapshot {
+        switch conflict.choice {
+        case .keepLocal:
+            return conflict.localDevice
+        case .useServer:
+            return KnownDeviceSnapshot(
+                deviceID: conflict.localDevice.deviceID,
+                deviceName: conflict.localDevice.deviceName,
+                deviceColor: conflict.localDevice.deviceColor,
+                deviceIsInGroup: conflict.localDevice.deviceIsInGroup,
+                knownDevicesTablePosition: conflict.localDevice.knownDevicesTablePosition,
+                hasCurrentLocationAccess: conflict.serverDevice.hasCurrentLocationAccess,
+                hasHistoryAccess: conflict.serverDevice.hasHistoryAccess
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    private func makeServerSnapshot(from serverDevice: MiataruAllowedDevice, fallbackPosition: Int) -> KnownDeviceSnapshot {
+        KnownDeviceSnapshot(
+            deviceID: serverDevice.DeviceID,
+            deviceName: defaultDeviceName(for: serverDevice.DeviceID),
+            deviceColor: defaultDeviceColor(for: serverDevice.DeviceID),
+            deviceIsInGroup: false,
+            knownDevicesTablePosition: fallbackPosition,
+            hasCurrentLocationAccess: serverDevice.hasCurrentLocationAccess,
+            hasHistoryAccess: serverDevice.hasHistoryAccess
+        )
+    }
+
+    private func defaultDeviceName(for deviceID: String) -> String {
+        let shortID = String(deviceID.prefix(8))
+        return String(format: NSLocalizedString("Restored Device %@", comment: "Fallback name for a restored device entry"), shortID)
+    }
+
+    private func defaultDeviceColor(for deviceID: String) -> UIColor {
+        let palette: [UIColor] = [
+            .systemBlue, .systemGreen, .systemOrange, .systemPink, .systemPurple,
+            .systemTeal, .systemRed, .systemIndigo, .systemYellow, .systemMint
+        ]
+        let hash = abs(deviceID.uppercased().hashValue)
+        return palette[hash % palette.count]
+    }
+
+    private func withPosition(_ snapshot: KnownDeviceSnapshot, position: Int) -> KnownDeviceSnapshot {
+        KnownDeviceSnapshot(
+            deviceID: snapshot.deviceID,
+            deviceName: snapshot.deviceName,
+            deviceColor: snapshot.deviceColor,
+            deviceIsInGroup: snapshot.deviceIsInGroup,
+            knownDevicesTablePosition: position,
+            hasCurrentLocationAccess: snapshot.hasCurrentLocationAccess,
+            hasHistoryAccess: snapshot.hasHistoryAccess
+        )
+    }
+
+    private func normalizePositions(_ snapshots: inout [KnownDeviceSnapshot]) {
+        snapshots = snapshots.enumerated().map { index, snapshot in
+            KnownDeviceSnapshot(
+                deviceID: snapshot.deviceID,
+                deviceName: snapshot.deviceName,
+                deviceColor: snapshot.deviceColor,
+                deviceIsInGroup: snapshot.deviceIsInGroup,
+                knownDevicesTablePosition: index,
+                hasCurrentLocationAccess: snapshot.hasCurrentLocationAccess,
+                hasHistoryAccess: snapshot.hasHistoryAccess
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    private func restoreGroups(_ snapshots: [DeviceGroupRestoreSnapshot]) {
+        let groups = snapshots
+            .sorted { $0.groupPosition < $1.groupPosition }
+            .map { snapshot -> DeviceGroup in
+                let group = DeviceGroup(name: snapshot.groupName)
+                group.deviceIDs = snapshot.deviceIDs
+                group.groupPosition = snapshot.groupPosition
+                return group
+            }
+        groupStore.groups = groups
+    }
+
+    private func migrateGroups(from oldDeviceID: String, to newDeviceID: String) {
+        let normalizedOldID = oldDeviceID.uppercased()
+        let normalizedNewID = newDeviceID.uppercased()
+        for group in groupStore.groups {
+            var updatedIDs = group.deviceIDs
+            let containsOld = updatedIDs.contains { $0.uppercased() == normalizedOldID }
+            guard containsOld else { continue }
+            updatedIDs = Set(updatedIDs.filter { $0.uppercased() != normalizedOldID })
+            if !updatedIDs.contains(where: { $0.uppercased() == normalizedNewID }) {
+                updatedIDs.insert(newDeviceID)
+            }
+            group.deviceIDs = updatedIDs
+        }
+    }
+
+    private func filterGroupsToKnownDevices() {
+        let validIDs = Set(deviceStore.devices.map { $0.DeviceID.uppercased() })
+        for group in groupStore.groups {
+            let filtered = Set(group.deviceIDs.filter { validIDs.contains($0.uppercased()) })
+            if filtered != group.deviceIDs {
+                group.deviceIDs = filtered
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private func copyOwnCaches(from oldDeviceID: String, to newDeviceID: String) {
+        if let oldLocation = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.getLocation(for: oldDeviceID),
+           DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.getLocation(for: newDeviceID) == nil {
+            DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(
+                for: newDeviceID,
+                latitude: oldLocation.latitude,
+                longitude: oldLocation.longitude,
+                accuracy: oldLocation.accuracy,
+                timestamp: oldLocation.timestamp,
+                batteryLevel: oldLocation.batteryLevel,
+                altitude: oldLocation.altitude,
+                speed: oldLocation.speed
+            )
+            DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setPlacemark(
+                for: newDeviceID,
+                country: oldLocation.country,
+                locality: oldLocation.locality,
+                timeZone: oldLocation.timeZone
+            )
+        }
+
+        if let oldHistory = DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.getHistory(for: oldDeviceID),
+           DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.getHistory(for: newDeviceID) == nil {
+            DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.setHistory(oldHistory, for: newDeviceID)
+        }
+
+        if let oldSlogan = DeviceSloganCacheStore.shared.slogan(for: oldDeviceID),
+           DeviceSloganCacheStore.shared.slogan(for: newDeviceID) == nil {
+            DeviceSloganCacheStore.shared.cacheSlogan(oldSlogan, for: newDeviceID)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private func restoreTrackingStateAfterAuthRecovery() {
+        if settings.trackAndReportLocationDisabledByDeviceKeyAuth {
+            settings.trackAndReportLocationDisabledByDeviceKeyAuth = false
+            if !settings.trackAndReportLocation {
+                settings.trackAndReportLocation = true
+            }
+        }
+        if settings.trackAndReportLocation {
+            LocationManager.shared.startTracking()
+        }
+    }
+}

    @MainActor
    private func fetchAllowedDeviceListComparison(deviceID: String, deviceKey: String) async {
        guard let serverURL = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else { return }

        isRestoring = true
        defer { isRestoring = false }

        do {
            let allowedList = try await MiataruAppAPI.getAllowedDeviceList(
                serverURL: serverURL,
                deviceID: deviceID,
                deviceKey: deviceKey
            )
            comparisonBaseline = DeviceRestoreCoordinator.shared.captureCurrentState()
            restoreComparison = DeviceRestoreCoordinator.shared.buildComparison(serverList: allowedList)
            showComparisonSheet = true
            retryAllowedDeviceListFetch = false
            setStatus(
                String(localized: "backup_restore_restore_validated", defaultValue: "Identity restored. Review the server-side allowed device list before the final sync.", comment: "Status message after identity restore and before ACL comparison")),
                isError: false
            )
        } catch {
            retryAllowedDeviceListFetch = true
            setStatus(
                String(localized: "backup_restore_acl_download_failed", defaultValue: "Identity restored, but downloading the allowed device list failed. Retry the download before you continue with ACL changes.", comment: "Error after identity restore if ACL download fails")) + "\n\n" + error.localizedDescription,
                isError: true
            )
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    private func handleComparisonCancel() {
        showComparisonSheet = false
        restoreComparison = nil
        comparisonBaseline = nil
        setStatus(
            String(localized: "backup_restore_comparison_cancelled", defaultValue: "Restore completed without importing or syncing the server-side allowed device list.", comment: "Status message when ACL comparison was cancelled")),
            isError: false
        )
    }

    @MainActor
    private func applyComparison(mode: AllowedDeviceRestoreApplyMode) async {
        guard let restoreComparison, let baseline = comparisonBaseline else { return }

        isRestoring = true
        let resultSnapshots = DeviceRestoreCoordinator.shared.resultSnapshots(for: restoreComparison, mode: mode)
        DeviceRestoreCoordinator.shared.applyDeviceSnapshots(resultSnapshots)

        do {
            try await DeviceRestoreCoordinator.shared.syncAppliedAllowedDeviceList(trigger: .restore)
            showComparisonSheet = false
            self.restoreComparison = nil
            comparisonBaseline = nil
            retryAllowedDeviceListFetch = false
            setStatus(
                String(localized: "backup_restore_acl_sync_success", defaultValue: "Restore and allowed-device-list sync completed.", comment: "Success message after final restore sync")),
                isError: false
            )
        } catch {

                isError: true
            )
        }

        isRestoring = false
    }

    private func setStatus(_ message: String?, isError: Bool) {
        statusMessage = message
        statusIsError = isError
    }

    private func defaultDeviceColor(for deviceID: String) -> UIColor {
        let palette: [UIColor] = [
            .systemBlue, .systemGreen, .systemOrange, .systemPink, .systemPurple,
            .systemTeal, .systemRed, .systemIndigo, .systemYellow, .systemMint
        ]
        let hash = abs(deviceID.uppercased().hashValue)

    private var copyOverlay: some View {
        Group {
            if let copiedMessage {
                VStack {
                    Spacer()
                    Text(copiedMessage)
                        .font(.body.weight(.medium))
                        .foregroundColor(.white)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 20)

                        .background(
                            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12)

                        )
                    Spacer()
                }
                .transition(.opacity)

        }
    }

    private func copyToPasteboard(_ value: String, message: String) {
        guard !value.isEmpty else { return }
        UIPasteboard.general.string = value
        withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2)) {
            copiedMessage = message
        }
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2) {
            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2)) {
                copiedMessage = nil
            }
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    private func performRestore() async {

        let deviceKey = pendingRestoreDeviceKey

            setStatus(

        ]
        let hash = abs(deviceID.uppercased().hashValue)

final class ExtendedUITests: XCTestCase {
    private let baseLaunchArguments = [
        "-ui-testing",
        "-ui-reset-userdefaults",
        "-ui-disable-location-tracking"
    ]

    override func setUpWithError() throws {
        continueAfterFailure = false
    }

    @MainActor
    func testLaunchWithCompletedOnboardingShowsRootTabs() throws {
        let app = launchApp(extraArguments: ["-ui-onboarding-completed"])

        XCTAssertTrue(app.otherElements["root_tab_view"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "Root tab view should be visible")
        XCTAssertFalse(app.otherElements["onboarding_container"].exists, "Onboarding should not be shown")
        XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.firstMatch.exists, "Tab bar should be visible")
        XCTAssertFalse(app.alerts.firstMatch.exists, "Unexpected alert visible at launch")
    }

    @MainActor
    func testDevicesAddSheetCanOpenAndCancel() throws {
        let app = launchApp(extraArguments: ["-ui-onboarding-completed"])

        XCTAssertTrue(app.otherElements["root_tab_view"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "Root tab view should be visible")
        XCTAssertTrue(selectTab(in: app, index: 0, expectedScreenIdentifier: "screen_devices"), "Devices tab should be active")

        let addButton = app.buttons["devices_add_button"]
        XCTAssertTrue(addButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "Add-device button should exist")
        addButton.tap()

    private func launchApp(extraArguments: [String]) -> XCUIApplication {
        let app = XCUIApplication()

        return app

    private func waitForNonExistence(of element: XCUIElement, timeout: TimeInterval) -> Bool {
        let predicate = NSPredicate(format: "exists == false")
        let expectation = XCTNSPredicateExpectation(predicate: predicate, object: element)
        return XCTWaiter.wait(for: [expectation], timeout: timeout) == .completed
    }

    @MainActor
    private func waitForElementByScrollingUp(in app: XCUIApplication, element: XCUIElement, maxSwipes: Int) -> Bool {
        if element.waitForExistence(timeout: 2) {
            return true
        }

        for _ in 0..<maxSwipes {
            app.swipeUp()
            if element.waitForExistence(timeout: 1) {
                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

version 3.1.4
- Extended `MiataruClientSwift` with typed support for `getAllowedDeviceList` (`MiataruGetAllowedDeviceList` request and `MiataruAllowedDeviceList` response model).
- Added `MiataruAPIClient.getAllowedDeviceList(...)` for authenticated owner reads against `v1/getAllowedDeviceList`.
- Updated `MiataruClientSwift` README with usage documentation and example code for `getAllowedDeviceList`.
- Fixed intermittent Devices-list refresh flicker where rows briefly dropped all supplemental information and showed only the device name during active polling.
- Coalesced overlapping device-list refresh requests into a single in-flight fetch and now apply refreshed device-location cache data as one consolidated snapshot instead of publishing per-device partial states.
- Kept the last successful device-location cache visible on transient refresh failures, avoiding the short-lived blank/half-empty list state during network hiccups.
- Fixed standard navigation summary countdown on iPhone and iPad so ETA/distance no longer jump from the initially correct route values to `0 km / 0 min` right after route calculation.
- Standard `device -> user` navigation now seeds live summary updates from the moment the active route is applied (including cached routes), instead of reusing potentially stale device sample timestamps.
- Added centralized device-slogan cleansing before every `setDeviceSlogan` request (remove control characters, trim outer whitespace, enforce max length 40) so invalid special/control characters are not sent to the server.
- Replaced raw server error text in slogan-save UI with a user-friendly localized fallback message ("Beim Setzen des Device Slogans ist etwas schief gelaufen. Probier es später noch einmal.") across all supported app languages.
- Added optional slogan rendering in the Devices tab list rows (iPhone + iPad): when a device slogan exists, it is shown directly below the device name.
- Matched device-list slogan styling to Visitor History by using secondary text color for a consistent, slightly darker subtitle appearance.
- Extended reversed-route live summary updates to normal (non-double-tap) navigation mode, so ETA/distance/arrival stay continuously in sync outside focused mode as well.
- Simplified navigation duration formatting to hour+minute granularity only (removed seconds) for more compact route info on smaller devices.
- Simplified the iOS 26 bottom accessory arrival segment to show only the arrival clock time, removing the localized `ETA:`/`Ankunft:` prefix.
- Extended `MiataruClientSwift` with typed support for `getDeviceSecurityStatus` (`MiataruGetDeviceSecurityStatus` request and `MiataruDeviceSecurityStatus` response model).
- Added `MiataruAPIClient.getDeviceSecurityStatus(...)` for authenticated security-status checks against `v1/getDeviceSecurityStatus`.
- Added app-level wrapper `MiataruAppAPI.getDeviceSecurityStatus(...)` so app callsites can use the centralized request executor and read retry policy.
- Updated `MiataruClientSwift` README with usage documentation and example code for `getDeviceSecurityStatus`.
- Added a new first security-status row in Edit Device `Access Permissions` that loads on open via `getDeviceSecurityStatus` and shows DeviceKey + ACL status text with symbols.
- Added status color coding in that row: active (`green`), inactive (`red`), unknown/loading (`secondary`) with unknown fallback on missing credentials or API/auth/network errors.
- Added full localization coverage for the new Edit Device security-status texts across all supported app languages (`da`, `de`, `en`, `es`, `fi`, `fr`, `it`, `ja`, `nl`, `zh-Hans`).

version 3.1.3
- Added an opt-in unknown-visitor alert feature (`unknownVisitorAlertsEnabled`, default `off`) with a centralized notification permission flow that is reused by Settings and Onboarding.
- Added a new full-onboarding step `iPhone_9_OnboardingUnknownVisitorAlertsView` (shown only when location tracking is enabled) with feature explanation, example notification text, live toggle, denied-state hint, and app-settings shortcut.
- Integrated unknown-visitor evaluation after successful location delivery for both direct `submit(...).sent` and outbox flush paths.
- Added `UnknownVisitorAlertService` as a central alert engine with watermark-based incremental processing, own/known/ignored-device filtering, per-device 24-hour cooldown, and in-flight coalescing.
- Implemented start-at-enable behavior for alert evaluation (no retroactive notifications before activation timestamp).
- Implemented best-effort enrichment for notification text (device slogan + city), including resilient fallback message when enrichment data is unavailable.

# Allowed Device List Read API Client Integration (2026-03-13)

## Goal
Add support for the new Miataru API endpoint `getAllowedDeviceList` in the shared Swift client so the stored ACL of an owner device can be fetched in a typed way.

## Implemented Changes

### MiataruClientSwift
Updated `miataru/Libraries/MiataruClientSwift/Sources/MiataruAPIClient/MiataruAPIClient.swift`:

- Added typed request body:
  - `GetAllowedDeviceListRequestBody`
- Added typed request payload:
  - `GetAllowedDeviceListPayload`
- Added typed response models:
  - `MiataruAllowedDeviceList`
  - `MiataruGetAllowedDeviceListResponse`
- Added new public API method:
  - `MiataruAPIClient.getAllowedDeviceList(serverURL:deviceID:deviceKey:)`
- Removed an existing non-functional Swift warning in `SkipDecodable` by changing `var keyed` to `let keyed`

Request path and payload naming match `Miataru.yaml`:
- Path: `v1/getAllowedDeviceList`
- Request root key: `MiataruGetAllowedDeviceList`
- Response root key: `MiataruAllowedDeviceList`

### Response Shape
The new response model exposes:
- `DeviceID`
- `IsAllowedDeviceListEnabled`
- `allowedDevices`

Each allowlist entry is decoded as existing `MiataruAllowedDevice` values.

## Documentation
Updated package usage docs:
- `miataru/Libraries/MiataruClientSwift/README.md`
  - Added a usage section and sample code for `getAllowedDeviceList`

Updated release notes:
- `miataru/CHANGELOG.md`

```diff
+# Backup & Restore for Device Identity (2026-03-13)
+
+## Goal
+Add an end-user facing backup and restore flow for `DeviceID` + `DeviceKey`, integrate iOS password-friendly fields and Keychain mirroring, and extend restore so the server-side allowed-device list can be reviewed, merged and synced back deliberately.
+
+## User-Facing Flow
+
+### Settings
+- `Show Onboarding Wizard Again` now lives in `Location Tracking Details`, directly below the version card.
+- Settings now expose a dedicated `Backup and Restore` entry beneath `Location Tracking Details`.
+
+### Backup and Restore Screen
+- Shows the current `DeviceID`
+- Shows the current `DeviceKey` in masked form with explicit reveal
+- Supports copy/share actions for `DeviceID`, `DeviceKey`, and a combined export payload
+- Explains how users can treat `DeviceID` as username and `DeviceKey` as password in a password manager
+- Uses password-friendly field metadata:
+  - `DeviceID` fields -> `.username`
+  - `DeviceKey` fields -> `.password`
+
+### Restore Flow
+1. User enters `DeviceID` and `DeviceKey`
+2. App validates credentials against `getDeviceSecurityStatus`
+3. On success, the app swaps the local owner identity in place
+4. App downloads the server-side allowed-device list via `getAllowedDeviceList`
+5. App shows a comparison sheet with:
+   - conflict devices present both locally and on the server
+   - server-only devices
+   - local-only devices
+6. User chooses one of:
+   - cancel comparison
+   - replace local ACL-relevant list with server state
+   - apply a selective merge
+7. App syncs the final resolved ACL immediately with `setAllowedDeviceList`
+
+## Local State Rules
+- `UserDefaults` remains the source of truth for `deviceKey`
+- Keychain is a mirrored supplemental store for system integration and convenience
+- If `UserDefaults` and Keychain diverge, `UserDefaults` wins
+- Restore updates:
+  - active own `DeviceID`
+  - active own `DeviceKey`
+  - auth-block flags
+  - own `KnownDevice` row
+  - group references containing the old own device ID
+  - `lastOpenedDeviceID` when it pointed to the old own device
+  - cached location/history/slogan data for the own device when the new identity has no cache yet
+
+## Allowed Device List Merge Rules
+
+### Replace Local With Server
+- Rebuild the ACL-relevant local list from server state
+- Preserve the local owner row when possible
+- Create default local name/color metadata for server-only devices
+- Remove local-only devices from the ACL-relevant list
+
+### Selective Merge
+- Local list is the baseline
+- Conflict rows let the user choose:
+  - keep local ACL
+  - use server ACL
+- Server-only devices are opt-in
+- Local-only devices remain untouched
+- Local name/color/group metadata always stays local
+
+## Rollback and Failure Handling
+- If credential validation fails, nothing changes locally
+- If `getAllowedDeviceList` fails after identity restore:
+  - restored identity remains active
+  - no ACL sync is triggered
+  - user gets a retry path
+- If final ACL sync fails after the comparison decision:
+  - ACL/device-list changes from the comparison step are rolled back
+  - restored identity remains active
+
+## Security Notes
+- `DeviceKey` is effectively the secret proving ownership of a Miataru device identity
+- Copy/share/reveal actions are intentionally explicit because screenshots, clipboard history, and synced password managers can leak the secret
+- The app does not promise direct insertion into the Apple Passwords app; it provides Keychain mirroring, copy/share, and iOS AutoFill-compatible input metadata
+- Restoring credentials on another installation means future owner-protected actions and tracking updates are associated with the restored identity
```

@@
 version 3.1.4
+- Moved `Show Onboarding Wizard Again` from Settings into `Location Tracking Details`, directly below the version summary.
+- Added a new `Backup and Restore` screen in Settings to explain and expose the current `DeviceID` and `DeviceKey`, including copy/share actions and password-manager guidance.
+- Added iOS password-friendly metadata for Miataru identity fields so `DeviceID` can participate as username and `DeviceKey` as password in AutoFill-capable restore and key-entry flows.
+- Added `DeviceCredentialStore` Keychain mirroring for the current `DeviceKey` while keeping `UserDefaults` as the app's canonical source of truth.
+- Added app-level `MiataruAppAPI.getAllowedDeviceList(...)` usage in the restore flow and a new interactive ACL comparison sheet for conflict resolution, selective merge, full replacement, retry, and rollback on failed final sync.
+- Added in-place identity restore support that updates the local owner device entry, device groups, auth flags, cache carry-over, and related local state before the final ACL reconciliation step.
 - Extended `MiataruClientSwift` with typed support for `getAllowedDeviceList` (`MiataruGetAllowedDeviceList` request and `MiataruAllowedDeviceList` response model).
 - Added `MiataruAPIClient.getAllowedDeviceList(...)` for authenticated owner reads against `v1/getAllowedDeviceList`.
 - Updated `MiataruClientSwift` README with usage documentation and example code for `getAllowedDeviceList`.

            'ja':'パスワードマネージャーに保存する場合は、DeviceID をユーザー名、DeviceKey をパスワードとして使ってください。iOS が自動入力候補を表示することはありますが、Miataru は Apple の Passwords アプリへの直接保存を保証しません。',
            'nl':'Gebruik de DeviceID als gebruikersnaam en de DeviceKey als wachtwoord als je dit in een wachtwoordmanager opslaat. iOS kan AutoFill-suggesties tonen, maar Miataru garandeert geen directe opslag in de Passwords-app van Apple.',
            'zh-Hans':'如果你要把这些信息保存在密码管理器中，请将 DeviceID 作为用户名、DeviceKey 作为密码。iOS 可能会提供自动填充建议，但 Miataru 不保证能直接保存到 Apple 的 Passwords 应用。',
        },
    },
